title: RAW_UNSCREENED: Äußere Wärme und innere Vereisung
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: f77r.37 has teeolain chey qoteedy qokain cheedy cheey lchedy, allowing a warm-surroundings/cold-interior meteorological reading with a physical recoil, against a hydraulic warm-flow reading.

design.scope_description: Only already exposed f77r text/labels and cached Aristotle I.9-12 source; no new image or selector.
design.mechanism: Antiperistasis reading assigns contrasting outer condition and inner response; rival treats the line as one ordinary thermal or motion sequence.
design.unit: Exact whole-form sequences at named f77r loci.
design.contrast: Thermal recoil with opposite internal response versus uniform hydraulic process
design.prediction: The recoil model predicts a written polarity reversal within one clause and a later state/result relation; hydraulic reading predicts one polarity and a directional complement without reversal.
concrete_observations: GDT936 preserves the exact seven-group f77r.37 line and its two fixed motion/rest readings; Aristotle I.12 states warm surroundings can concentrate cold and freeze water near the earth.
linked_consequences: Recoil requires both contrasting state forms in the same written span; hydraulic reading requires a written motion target and no hidden cold response.
design.nearest_rival: Thermal recoil with opposite internal response versus uniform hydraulic process
design.distinguishing_observation: Check the exact adjacency/order of qoteedy, cheedy, cheey and lchedy and whether the same polarity contrast recurs in another exposed line; no gloss is evidence by itself.
assumption_costs: Aristotle is only a historical comparator
design.strongest_likely_failure: The thermal polarity of the forms is assumed, and the line may be an ordinary conditional or unrelated record.
